MY TASK MANAGER
===============

SETUP (one time, about 1 minute)
1. Download MyTaskManager.exe from
   https://github.com/trmiizi/my-task-manager/releases/latest
   If the browser says the file "isn't commonly downloaded": click ... > Keep.
2. Move it somewhere permanent, e.g. Documents\MyTaskManager\
   (not the Downloads folder).
3. Double-click MyTaskManager.exe.
   If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC": click "More info" > "Run anyway".
   (This appears the first time because the app isn't signed by a publisher.)
4. Done. A sticky note appears on the desktop, and the app starts by itself
   every time Windows starts.

THE STICKY NOTE
- Shows overdue, today's and tomorrow's tasks (or the whole week: ... button).
- Tick box: click once = Done (green tick), twice = Not done (red cross),
  three times = back to pending. Right-click a task for more options.
- Click "+ Add a task" at the bottom (or + at the top). A panel slides up:
  type the task, tap a day (Today / Tomorrow / Other day) and a time
  (9am / 12pm / 3pm / 6pm / Other), then press Enter or click Add task.
  Typing the day and time also works, e.g.
     Call Ali tomorrow 3pm
     Hantar borang esok 9.30am
- Drag the top bar to move it. Drag any edge or corner to resize it,
  like a normal window. (Locking the note stops both.)
- Top buttons: + add, pin (keep on top), ... (whole week, lock in place,
  colour, photo background), open the full app, hide.
  Bring a hidden note back: right-click the tray icon > Show sticky note.

REMINDERS
- A card pops up bottom-right: Done, Not done, Snooze 10 min, or 1 hour.
- Ignore it and it comes back after 10 minutes (change this in Settings).
- If the PC was off or asleep, the reminder appears as soon as it is back on.

THE FULL APP (click the tray icon by the clock, or the open button on the note)
- Today / Tomorrow / Upcoming: add tasks with date, time, reminder and repeat
  (daily, weekdays, weekly, monthly).
- Checklist: Edit a task (or right-click > Add checklist) to add steps.
- History: everything Done and Not done. Filter, search, and add remarks.
- Archive: tidy away finished tasks with "Archive ticked" (Today / Tomorrow),
  "Archive all" (History), the box icon on a task, or the note's ... menu.
  See them again in History > Archived; the up-arrow icon brings one back.
- "Switch to sticky note" button (top right) hides the app (it keeps running by the clock) and shows the note.
- Moon button (top right) or Settings > Appearance: dark mode.
- Settings & backup: test reminder, sound, sticky note options,
  start with Windows, export/import backup, remove from this PC.

UPDATES
- Settings & backup > Check for updates. If a new version is out, an
  "Update to ..." button appears: click it and the app restarts by itself in a
  few seconds. Your tasks and settings are kept. It never updates on its own.
- What's new (in the sidebar) lists what changed in each version.
- Latest version: https://github.com/trmiizi/my-task-manager/releases/latest

GOOD TO KNOW
- The PC must be on for a reminder to pop up.
- Closing the window keeps the app running by the clock so reminders work.
  To quit completely: right-click the tray icon > Exit.
- Tasks are saved in %APPDATA%\MyTaskManager (daily backups kept 14 days).
- To uninstall: Settings & backup > Remove My Task Manager from this PC.
